_comment: Token pattern -> the container's width in em (container px / font px). First match wins, so specific patterns come before general ones. Only long strings need an entry; anything not listed is left for TMP to lay out, which is correct for text that fits on one line. Wrapping NARROWER than the container is always safe - TMP only re-wraps, and re-wrapping is what inverts the line order. Calibrated in-game: each number is measured off a line the game itself fitted without breaking. When one token is drawn in two containers, the NARROWER one decides - a skill description appears both in the character-select list (34 em) and in the loadout tooltip (26 em), so it is wrapped for the tooltip.
